title: Briefing attendees rebuild the Aquarius briefing from memory in a motel

tellings.quote: They the guys of the in the briefing got together afterwards, went to a motel and they basically wrote down from memory uh what they recalled about the briefing

plain: A physicist, Eric Davis, says that in 1977 some people sat through a secret briefing about Project Aquarius, said to be a hidden US government UFO programme. According to Davis, the men from the briefing then went to a motel near Washington and wrote down from memory everything they recalled, and he names Alonzo McDonald, a White House official, and Bill Moore, a UFO researcher, in connection with it. If true, it would mean a written record of a secret UFO briefing exists only because people rebuilt it by hand.
